answer: The design leans on sharding with cross-shard communication protocols. Written in a first-principles reasoning, builds from axioms register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the ivory of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The cipher lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the zephyr is where a second reviewer recomputes them.
